title: Mirasol House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Discover the pinnacle of coastal luxury at this pristine property in the Crossings District, a stunning showcase of upscale living and thoughtful design. Inside, the spacious layout spans four bedrooms, plus a bonus bunk space, and four bathrooms, each reflecting a blend of sophistication and comfort. The home welcomes visitors with warm walnut floors, elegant shiplap walls, and decor that exemplifies prestige. A gourmet kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, a wine cooler, and a striking marble island, invites both culinary exploration and social gatherings. The seamless integration of kitchen, dining, and living areas maintains an airy open concept, ensuring that guests feel connected regardless of their activity. Outside, this home extends its luxury to a private oasis, perfect for relaxation and entertainment. A private pool, an outdoor grill station, and a cozy fireplace set the stage for unforgettable evenings under the stars. Guests can begin their retreat on the charming wooden front porch, outfitted with a delightful porch swing, or find solace on the covered deck with tranquil views of the lush backyard. The property also includes an outdoor shower for ultimate convenience after a day at the beach. Adding to the allure, a six-seat golf cart is available for guests to explore the many amenities of WaterColor. This home is not just a stay, but a complete, exquisite experience designed to make every moment of your vacation distinctly memorable.
